intelligence.essence: His question: "you don't think the answer is to go to Cloudflare and upload all the pictures so that you have them?" The verified answer is a split, not a blanket yes: the 27 slide pictures do NOT need it — they are already bundled inside the file, verified intact; display is the issue, not storage. The 14 portraits DO — they can't get into the artifact in this VM (write filter), and uploading them to the nayanet-welcome-assets KV store and having the page load them from there gets around the block entirely. The upload was offered; awaiting his yes.
